note: Rewritten from Emerson's account of the termites of Kartabo, original in English. The book treats the species under the old combination Leucotermes tenuis (Hagen) (Hagen's original description based on Brazilian material), and Emerson worked from alates and soldiers from Kartabo and Dunoon. In the scan this passage begins in the middle of a figure caption ("…ie middle about the same color"), and four rows of values in the soldier measurement table are damaged; both are noted in the text.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Clearly distinct from L. crinitus: the soldier has far fewer hairs on the head, and the alate has smaller compound eyes.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head (the text breaks off at the start of this passage in the OCR and the first half of the sentence is missing): the middle is about the same colour as the rest; the anterior margin of the pronotum is concave, the sides converging posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly concave. In dealate specimens the forewing scales do not meet in the middle, and the posterior margin of the mesonotum is clearly visible behind the wing scales. The posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are slightly concave. The wings are pale and clouded. The legs are yellow. The abdominal tergites bear long hairs and are brownish yellow. Measurements: length with wings 10.64 mm, length without wings 5.32—6.50 mm; head length 1.29 mm, head width 1.00—1.03 mm; antennal length 2.09 mm; eye diameter 0.28 mm; pronotum length 0.52 mm, width 0.80 mm; hind tibia length 1.03 mm; forewing length 8.27 mm, width 2.13 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, long, with parallel and slightly rounded sides; the head bears sparse scattered hairs. The antennae have 15—17 segments. The mandibles are dark reddish brown, their inner edge smooth apart from a few small teeth near the base. The frontal gland appears as a small dark spot in the middle of the frons. The pronotum is yellow, its anterior margin concave and its posterior margin slightly concave, the sides and corners rounded, the hairs rather sparse. The legs are yellow. The abdomen is yellow with rather sparse hairs on the tergites. Measurements: head length 2.41—2.80 mm, antennal length 1.61—1.70 mm, pronotum width 0.93 mm, length of the left mandible 1.16—1.25 mm (the values for total length, head width, pronotum length and hind tibia length are damaged by OCR in the original and are not recorded).
